Visual scheme: editorial/paper-magazine/documentary-hero; composition = full-height or dominant editorial image with a protected quiet text margin and controlled subject crop; imagery = documentary photography with honest light, tactile detail and a single readable subject; requirements = subject must not cross the text-safe zone; image carries the narrative without invented labels.
Title treatment: {"mode":"caption","scale":"small-to-medium","placement":"top-left","weight":"restrained sans caption or short serif claim"}; a page may use a medium conclusion, statement, caption or integrated text instead of an oversized title.
Frozen layout plan: text safe zone = top-left; visual zone = center, right; hierarchy = caption, documentary-scene, short-support; density = low.
Scene and visual brief: 纪录感服务现场：桌面、纸张和一个正在处理问题的人物被自然裁切，左侧纸面保留安静文字区，不出现可读招牌。
Text (verbatim; render every line exactly once, with correct Chinese characters and punctuation):

2. "从服务现场开始"
Evidence constraints (do not turn evidence into extra visible labels unless it is also in exact_text): []
Typography: use the specified Chinese type pairing and a readable hierarchy; keep line breaks intentional; do not force every page into a giant headline and do not shrink text to fit.
Text safety: carbon-black or deep marine text on a quiet ivory or matte charcoal field; never place type over a face, high-frequency texture or bright highlight; no face, object, highlight, grid, or light path may pass behind the letters.
Information boundary: use only the supplied visible text; do not invent metrics, labels, citations, UI, logos, product screens, names, dates, or claims.
Constraints: render the complete slide as one finished image; preserve a clear visual hierarchy; keep generous margins; use one dominant visual anchor; no editable UI; no watermark; no logo.
Avoid: stock-photo collage; text over eyes or faces; website cards; tech neon; perfect symmetry; generic luxury gold; oversized title on every page; extra words; misspelled Chinese; gibberish; tiny labels; dense card grids; busy detail behind text; decorative pseudo-data.
Continuity anchor: paper-crop; continuity group: field-notes.
